data.name: Ark+ Finetuning 50r client_api (arkplus-apps 8a188867)
data.description: Federated fine-tuning of the pretrained Ark+ (Swin-Large, 768px) chest X-ray foundation model for 5-finding classification. The encoder stays frozen; a fresh 5-class linear head is trained with FedAvg over 50 global rounds of 5 local epochs (batch size 4, Adam, exponential LR decay 1.5e-3 to 1.5e-4 during round 0, fixed thereafter; mean per-logit BCE loss). Only head parameter updates are exchanged, passed through a selective parameter-sharing privacy filter (10% quantile threshold), keeping per-round payloads in the tens of kilobytes after the round-0 checkpoint broadcast. The resulting global model will be compared against the pretrained baseline on each site's holdout cohort in a separate federated evaluation job.
